sources.title: keras/densenet_169_imagenet · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Overview DenseNet is a convolution network which densely connects each layer to every other layer in a feed-forward fashion. The model was originally evaluated on four object recognition benchmark tasks (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, and ImageNet). See the model card below for benchmarks, data sources, and intended use cases.

sources.title: Multilabel Classifier Using DenseNet-169 for Alzheimer's disease
sources.snippet: In the proposed work, a Deep Learning Classifier using Convolutional Neural Network is proposed for classifying the stage of Alzheimer's disease in a patient by using the DenseNet-169 CNN classifier with an accuracy of 91.80%. The model is trained on a MRI image database that contains MRI images of patients diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease.
